  id integer,
  name text,
  age integer
)
SERVER file_server
OPTIONS (
  filename '/path/to/your/file.csv',
  header true
);

1. **Modified (M):** The cache line is present only in the current cache, and it is modified (dirty). The main memory has a stale copy of the data.
2. **Exclusive (E):** The cache line is present only in the current cache, and it is not modified (clean). The main memory has an up-to-date copy of the data.
3. **Shared (S):** The cache line is present in the current cache and potentially in other caches. The main memory has an up-to-date copy of the data.
4. **Invalid (I):** The cache line is not present in the cache.
